name: Analista Moda
postStartCommand:
sudo service apache2 start && sudo sed -i 's|DocumentRoot /var/www/html|DocumentRoot /workspaces/Analista-Moda|g' /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf && echo '<Directory /workspaces/Analista-Moda>
    Options Indexes FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
</Directory>' | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf && sudo service apache2 restart
